correctness.rationale: The order-12 classification was independently reconstructed. Exhaustive residue-counting over every divisor gives the displayed uniformly distributed set counts by size and, up to affine equivalence for sizes at most six, exactly the consecutive representatives plus the two exceptional supports \(B_5=\{0,1,2,3,5\}\) and \(B_6=\{0,1,2,3,5,10\}\). Consecutive rows are full spark by the Vandermonde argument. Exact arithmetic in \(\mathbb Z[z]/(z^4-z^2+1)\) verifies zero maximal minors for both exceptional representatives, while a primitive 12th-root reduction modulo 1009 certifies every maximal minor of the consecutive representatives is nonzero. Affine invariance and complementary-minor symmetry then give precisely 48 bad size-five supports, 12 bad size-six supports, their 48 size-seven complements, and no others.
risks: The finite verifier is a complete N=12 certificate but does not prove a general composite-order theorem.
